headline: A hidden 'Voice' preview item in Claude's web menu suggests Anthropic may be testing a new voice feature, but nothing about it is confirmed.
score_reason: Kept at pool 5: a single outlet's sighting of an unreleased feature, hedged in the headline and the article.
importance_line: People who talk to Claude by voice could get a new voice experience and Anthropic might be building its own speech technology, but this rests on one hidden menu item, Anthropic has confirmed nothing and no date is known.
summary: The AI news site TestingCatalog reports that it spotted a hidden 'Voice' entry labelled 'Preview' in Claude's web navigation, which it says points to Anthropic's internal test environment rather than a public release, following Anthropic's recent addition of an optional, off-by-default setting for sharing voice recordings for model training. It is unclear whether this is a new real-time voice model, a redesigned interface or something else, and Claude already offers voice conversations on mobile, desktop and web.
notes: Read TestingCatalog in full. TestingCatalog does not say that the voice-data setting proves a new model; it says it could also support existing voice features.
